commentary.text: 90+7' John Brooks is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' James Maddison (Tottenham) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
90' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Luis Sinisterra comes onto the pitch to replace him.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90' A player from Bournemouth commits a rough challenge. John Brooks blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
87' Substitution. Pedro Porro makes way for Destiny Udogie (Tottenham).
87' John Brooks shows the yellow card to Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) for a heavy challenge.
86' A yellow card for a tackle by James Maddison (Tottenham). John Brooks doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
84' 2 - 2 Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Kepa Arrizabalaga to move before slotting the ball low into the middle of the goal!
84' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
83' A clumsy foul by Kepa Arrizabalaga (Bournemouth) and John Brooks blows his whistle. Tottenham are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
81' Substitution. Marcus Tavernier leaves the pitch and is replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).
81' Djed Spence (Tottenham) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
81' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
79' Bournemouth can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' An attempted cross from Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is cleared. Good work from Bournemouth as they win a corner.
77' John Brooks blows his whistle after Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
76' Bournemouth are ruled offside.
74' Corner kick. Bournemouth will have an opportunity.
73' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.
71' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Evanilson is replaced by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Scott (Bournemouth) replaces Ryan Christie.
71' A player from Bournemouth takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
69' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) has tested the patience of referee John Brooks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' What a fabulous football moment! Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) picks up a nice pass, slams the ball goalwards and his knuckleball ricochets off the left post and into the back of the net.

67' Good touch by Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) as he latched on to an accurate pass before attempting to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range shot. Unluckily for him, his attempt only rattles the left post.
65' 0 - 2 Evanilson (Bournemouth) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the bottom right corner of the net.
63' The referee points to the corner flag and Bournemouth will take a corner.
62' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the top left corner, but Guglielmo Vicario is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
61' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with James Maddison (Tottenham) replacing Rodrigo Bentancur.
61' Today's match ends for Cristian Gabriel Romero who will be replaced by Micky van de Ven (Tottenham).
60' A quickly taken corner by Bournemouth.

60' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bournemouth.
58' The ball is behind the touchline and Bournemouth will take a throw-in.
56' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
54' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he fails to change the score as his effort deflects away off the right post.
53' Celebrations are cut short for Bournemouth as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
53' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Bournemouth players aren’t happy.
52' Goal! Evanilson shows great vision to find Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
50' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
50' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
49' Kevin Danso (Tottenham) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
48' John Brooks interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth).
46' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Heung-Min Son comes on the pitch for Brennan Johnson (Tottenham).
46' Ange Postecoglou has made a change at the break. Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) has come on in place of Yves Bissouma.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) for a tough tackle.
42' 0 - 1 Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) meets a perfect cross from Milos Kerkez deep inside the box, and he produces an accurate strike which goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
39' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
34' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
32' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Pedro Porro (Tottenham), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
31' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is penalised for holding. John Brooks signals a set piece.
30' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) sees a yellow card from John Brooks after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
29' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
28' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Tottenham will take a free kick.
25' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
25' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul. Tottenham are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
24' The linesman signals a throw-in for Bournemouth.
23' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.

18' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. John Brooks blows his whistle for an infringement. Bournemouth win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
17' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) serves up a nice cross, but Kepa Arrizabalaga punches the ball away.
13' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
11' A player from Tottenham brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
10' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
9' A player from Bournemouth pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
7' Tottenham force a corner. They send men into the box.
6' A pass into the penalty area from Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) is intercepted by the defence. Tottenham will take a corner kick.

5' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the bottom left corner as Guglielmo Vicario produces a good save.
4' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but John Brooks ignores the protests.
2' The ball goes behind for a corner. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

1' The opposition back off Evanilson (Bournemouth), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the bottom right corner, but Guglielmo Vicario denies him with the save. It will be a corner kick for Bournemouth.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Tottenham will have the kick-off.
John Brooks got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
